name: Day_Plan
label: Day Plan
_about: Day plans (spec v1.4, Delivery 02 §4, DP-R1-R6): the ordered list of a team-day's jobs. One row per (Plan_Date, Installer). Stops is written only by server/modules/delivery-management/day-plans.mjs — a Service Appointment joins the list automatically once it becomes Scheduled for that team-day (DP-R1/R2); the dispatcher reorders it (DP-R3, optimistic concurrency on Version); it locks at dispatch (DP-R6/DS-R3).

fields.name: Driver
fields.label: Driver
fields.helpText: Carried from Daily_Team_Availability for display; not the source of truth for the pairing.

fields.name: Stops
fields.label: Stops
fields.helpText: Ordered: array position is the stop number (DP-R1). One row per stop: { SA_ID, Time_Slot, Loaded_Box_Count, Loading_Confirmed }.

fields.name: Version
fields.label: Version
fields.helpText: DP-R3: a reorder save must send the version it started from, or it is refused with 'This day changed, please refresh.'

fields.name: Locked
fields.label: Locked
fields.helpText: DP-R6/DS-R3: true once the pre-delivery gate passes and the day is dispatched. Further edits need the dispatcher.

fields.name: Driver_Signature
fields.label: Driver Signature
fields.helpText: DS-R2/G8: captured on the Dispatch screen.
